description: This source file defines a Swift module for managing watch notifications within an iOS app extension, including data models like WatchNotifyMessage and WatchPromptAction, and a central class WatchInboxStore that handles message consumption, state persistence, and local notifications.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: A final class responsible for handling incoming notifications, persisting state, and coordinating local notification display in a watchOS extension.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes an incoming WatchNotifyMessage, updates internal state, and triggers a local notification.

methods.name: restorePersistedState
methods.description: Restores the watch inbox state from UserDefaults if available.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Encodes current state into JSON and saves it to UserDefaults.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for message deduplication based on message ID or content.

methods.name: ensureNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and requests notification permissions asynchronously.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps message risk levels to corresponding haptic feedback types.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a draft reply for a user prompt based on an action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Marks the reply as being sent, updating status indicators.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates the reply status based on the sending result.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Schedules a local notification and triggers haptic feedback based on risk.
